_doc: ONE-SHOT, DIGEST-PINNED waiver of interlock precondition 5 (the independent clean-row bar). Valid ONLY while the live money-core digest equals `digest` below — any money-core edit voids it, the same F2 law that binds a ledger row, so a waiver can never become a permanent global token. Created by an owner ruling recorded in the operating harness's decisions log; a counter-ruling DELETES this file and the bar returns whole. A future release either meets the bar or carries a NEW recorded ruling with a fresh digest. This file ships with the tree ON PURPOSE: the public release-proof evaluates the same gate the source did, and a bar that was waived should say so in the open.
ruling: The owner waives the independent-review row for the portfolio-run repair release at this exact digest ('yes just rule it', 2026-08-17), the second use of the recorded-ruling channel — the prior waiver died when these fixes touched the money core, exactly as designed.
